title: Bounded away mode
summary: Away mode MUST continue enabled runs within operator guardrails and keep an immutable decision ledger.
instructions: Away mode MUST act only when the run snapshot enables it.
The top-level supervisor MUST consume safe pending actions until the run becomes terminal or reaches a denied blocker.
Disabled runs MUST keep every operator stop.
Away mode MUST classify denied decisions, exhausted limits, failed automation, and quarantined agents as blockers.
The hypervisor MUST handle agent health only and MUST NOT own ordinary workflow continuation.
The evaluator MUST rank bounded options and cite evidence for each option.
Pan code MUST reject malformed, unsupported, forbidden, or unguarded options.
Pan code MUST select the first allowed option with a complete manual rollback plan.
A successful ship packet MAY receive deterministic away approval when `approve` is allowed.
Deterministic ship approval MUST NOT consume the evaluated decision budget.

Away mode MUST NOT run push, publication, deployment, or branch-deletion actions. It MAY run a gate-waiver action when the guardrails allow it and the blocker is a criterion backed only by cost, speed, wall time, or administration, or a failure with a mechanical root cause. It SHOULD NOT waive a criterion that protects correctness or security.

A gate waiver is appropriate for a blocker with a mechanical or administrative root cause, for a criterion whose only backing is cost, speed, or wall time, and for a blocker whose blast radius is limited enough to remediate separately. The evaluator MUST carry the reason in the option note, and the harness MUST record that reason on the waiver.

A selected option that fails to apply MUST NOT end the task. The harness MUST record the failed apply and fall through to the next allowed ranked option. Only a ranking with no remaining allowed option is a blocker.

An evaluator failure (no reply, an unparseable reply, or a transport error) is transient. The harness MUST evaluate again within the evaluator-failure ceiling before it treats the blocker as unclearable.
The cohort plan route MAY create branches and worktrees under an away-mode approval, as the cohort policy provides.

Each successful evaluation and each apply result MUST append one immutable ledger record. An unparseable evaluator reply MUST be retried exactly once before an exhausted evaluation appends at most one terminal record.

Each evaluator transport and parse attempt MUST be recorded in distinct `away-evaluator-*.json` exchange evidence. Intermediate attempt errors and raw malformed replies MUST NOT enter the decision ledger.

The ledger MUST identify evaluated decisions, deterministic ship approvals, and hypervisor quarantine records. It MUST also identify exhausted evaluator failures as generic `evaluator_failure` records that consume no decision budget and reference their exchange evidence.
Applied away actions MUST record away authorship and MUST NOT record operator authorship.
The ledger MUST contain bounded summaries and repository-relative evidence references.
